messages:
lucas_ae: Quick thread for Olga (FinServ POC). They want committed capacity guidance for us-east with steady 180 req/s, bursts to 800 req/s for 10-25m, avg ~220 tokens, p95 latency target 500ms. Also need burst credits and a deterministic degrade path. Olga any extra constraints?
olga_customer: Must run in us-east, prefer H100-class perf, SOC2 + BYOK KMS, and explicit audit logs. We'll likely have week-long high-traffic windows next quarter.
neha_se: Back-of-envelope: for 220 tokens on H100-equivalent with quant model, expect ~100-140 req/s per GPU at 500ms depending on batch tuning. Conservative calc: use 110 req/s. So steady 180 -> reserve 2 GPUs. Peak 800 -> ~8 GPUs (800/110 ≈ 7.3). Add buffer -> max_pool 10. Also plan prewarm to avoid cold-start tail.
quinn_eng: Runtime notes: recommend mixed lanes: reserved low-latency lane (no batching >8ms), burst lane with larger batching. Autoscale snippet: ```yaml
reserved: 2
max_pool: 10
autoscale:
  scale_up_rps: 120
  scale_up_step: 2
  scale_down_delay_s: 240
prewarm: true
prewarm_nodes: 3
fallback_model: 13b-quant
fallback_trigger_ms: 200
```
riley_ops: Ops bits: enable cross-AZ routing, keep 1 warm standby in second AZ. For burst credits propose 30min of extra GPUs at peak (i.e., (10-2)=8 GPUs * 0.5h = 4 GPU-hours). Prewarm reduces cold starts but costs a bit. We'll draft a runbook for fallback routing and cache refill.
sam_fin: I'll sketch committed vs burst pricing. Initial note: commit 2 GPUs monthly + ephemeral for bursts. I'll make low/med/high cost scenarios once we pick SKU.
prewarm-bot: prewarm-job: scheduled warm of 3 nodes in us-east-1 at 2026-09-12T07:00Z for FinServ POC (pending approval).
lucas_ae: Next steps: 1) Olga provide token histogram + calendar for upcoming spikes. 2) Neha/Quinn produce conservative + cost-optimized sizing docs. 3) Sam posts cost sheet. 4) Riley drafts runbook. I'll consolidate and send to Olga by EOD Tue.
olga_customer: Got it, will upload histogram and spike dates today. Thanks all.
neha_se: I'll include a note about heavy-tail tokens — if >10% >1k tokens, bump reserve.
quinn_eng: Will add response flag when fallback used so customer can surface it in UI.
lucas_ae: Thanks team :thumbsup:
